title: anathallis jamaicensis
intro: Anathallis jamaicensis, commonly known as Jamaican anathallis, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. It is a terrestrial orchid found in Jamaica, known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Anathallis jamaicensis include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
